_note: Airstriker ships with stable-retro. Its sound plays a constant delay after each frame's flip; --no-audio mutes it. fps is this Genesis core's native rate: the session stops a block whose sound per step does not match 1/fps.
_keys_note: Genesis buttons for this core are [B, A, MODE, START, UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, C, Y, X, Z] and 'keys' values are button vectors in that order. Airstriker uses the D-pad to move and B to fire, so the map below is arrows + X (keyboard) -> B (console). The controls the subject sees are a plain 'message' phase; keep its text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

curriculum.text: Airstriker: arrows move, X fires; ESC quits.
